segments.caption: An aerial news report from Douglasville, Georgia, shows the aftermath of a serious collision where a red car is crushed under the front of a stopped freight train on a railroad track that runs adjacent to a highway. Emergency responders, including police and tow truck crews, are on the scene, and a news helicopter is visible overhead. The graphic "NEW DETAILS" indicates the report is providing updated information on the incident.

A news report details a train collision with a car in Douglasville, Georgia. The initial aerial shot shows the aftermath: a red car crushed on the train tracks next to a moving train, with emergency vehicles and personnel on scene. The report then uses maps to pinpoint the location at the intersection of East Broad Street and Mozley Street in Douglasville, near Atlanta, before transitioning to a reporter on location to provide further details on the incident.

A CBS Atlanta news reporter, Steve Kiggins, provides a live on-site report at night following a train collision with a car. The broadcast graphic identifies the incident location as the intersection of E Broad St and Mozley St in Douglasville, with a map displayed alongside the reporter.

A CBS Atlanta news reporter, Steve Kiggins, delivers a live on-air report from a dark, empty street in Douglasville, Douglas County, at night. He gestures toward the road as he speaks, providing new details about a story. The scene is illuminated by artificial lighting, with a temperature of 48 degrees displayed on screen.

A news report from Douglasville, Georgia, shows a nighttime scene at a railroad crossing where a train has collided with a red car. The footage begins with a live reporter on location, pointing toward the scene, before transitioning to an aerial view that clearly depicts the aftermath: the train's locomotive is stopped on the tracks, the red car is wedged against it, and emergency personnel are on the scene.

An aerial view captures the aftermath of a train collision with a red car at a railroad crossing, with emergency personnel and a police car on scene. The segment then cuts to ground-level shots showing responders at the site and a witness pointing towards the incident, indicating a serious accident involving a train and a vehicle at a busy intersection.

A news report from Atlanta covers a train crossing incident, showing railroad workers inspecting a derailed freight car on the tracks while a local resident, Robert Woods, gestures toward the scene, describing the event that occurred near his home.

A man gestures toward the scene of a train collision with a red car on railroad tracks in Douglasville, Georgia, as aerial footage shows the aftermath of the crash, with the train's locomotive stopped beside the damaged vehicle.

A red car is shown wedged on railroad tracks, having been struck by a train, with bystanders visible on the train's cab. The scene then cuts to a street-level view of vehicles crossing the tracks at a railroad crossing, highlighting the intersection of road and rail traffic.
A news reporter stands at a railroad crossing in Atlanta, speaking to the camera as trains pass overhead and cars drive by on the adjacent road.

The scene shifts to show construction workers in safety vests inspecting the crossing equipment, indicating an ongoing repair or investigation. The footage then cuts to a daytime view of cars navigating the intersection, highlighting the disruption to normal traffic flow. A news report documents a serious train collision with a red car on railroad tracks at an intersection in Atlanta. The footage shows the damaged vehicle wedged between the rails, with emergency personnel and onlookers present. A reporter stands at the scene, gesturing toward the wreckage, while aerial views capture the aftermath of the crash.

An aerial view captures the aftermath of a serious collision where a red car is crushed by a train on the tracks. Emergency responders and bystanders are present at the scene, with a tow truck arriving to remove the wreckage. The segment then cuts to ground-level interviews with witnesses, including a man speaking to the camera and two women observing from the roadside, providing eyewitness accounts of the incident.
